mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5% in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced economic activity and higher borrowing costs.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors react to the unexpected deterioration in labor market conditions.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises by more than 0.3pp in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals robust consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as companies benefit from increased sales and earnings.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when RSAFS increases for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a month signals supply chain disruptions or reduced manufacturing activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as companies face production challenges and reduced output.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO drops by more than 2% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment (CPIAUCSL below 2% annualized) signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate continued low interest rates and easy financial conditions.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL is below 2% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% in a month signals increased demand for new homes, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the housing sector and related industries benefit from the increased activity.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when HOUST increases by more than 5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and business investment are expected to increase.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as companies benefit from increased economic activity and consumer spending.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when GDPC1 increases for two consecutive quarters.
